note: A tagging brief: build an add-to-cart click rule in an existing property/library. The property already has the 'core' extension installed (reactor_list_extensions result), so a rule component built from core:: delegates passes the Phase 4 reference check. The agent should read the property's extensions and data elements before populating, build the rule component(s), and create/populate the library — never publish. Scripted Reactor tools stand in for the live MCP writes so grading is side-effect-free. reactor_* descriptions/schemas mirror the live catalog.
request: In Launch property "Acme Web" (library "Web Tagging Dev"), add a rule that tracks add-to-cart clicks: when a visitor clicks an element matching ".add-to-cart", run a custom-code action that sets digitalData.event to 'addToCart'. Populate the dev library with it — do not publish or build it to any environment.
